Deliverable consumer: OKR users and explicitly authorized agents → workstream: okr. Parent: [TXE-4393]() · Plan key: FL-16 · Tier: T2 ## Outcome Flow load fixture, recorded API, readiness, frame-time and live measurements, and fixes for misses (an index migration makes this T2). ## Parallel execution Planned instance: **CC1**, within Connor's selected pool **CC1, CC2, CC3 and CC5**. This is prospective allocation; the Instance label changes only after an actual worker is dispatched and verified. [Execution plan v2]() and [Coordinator handoff]() own scheduling. Preparation gates: FEATURE-COMPLETE. Interface-bound implementation gates: FEATURE-COMPLETE. The dependencies below are merge prerequisites. Earlier fixture/contract preparation is allowed, but cannot satisfy real integration, review or acceptance. ## Scope and acceptance boundary This ticket owns the following slice of the shared criteria: **RP-AC4, RP-AC5**. Where a criterion spans service, HTTP, UI, fixture or composed acceptance, this merge delivers the layer named in that slice; the owning specs and ticket map assign the remaining layers. Do not claim a later layer ran in this merge. ## Acceptance | ID | Criterion | Verification | | -- | -- | -- | | RP-AC4 | Every API, readiness and live target has a recorded p95 with fixture, hardware, build and method, and any miss has a fix or a recorded decision by the coordinator. | measurement record | | RP-AC5 | The map and table frame-time targets have recorded p95 and maximum frame times from the scripted interaction, measured separately from readiness, and any miss has a fix or a recorded decision. | measurement record | ## Dependencies [TXE-4409]() (FL-15) Dependency rationale from the reviewed plan: FL-15 (complete, integrated feature). ## Source of record [Flow architecture and decisions]() · [18 product decisions]() · [Delivery and criterion mapping]() * [Release Acceptance Performance and Security]() ## Completion evidence Run the verification for this slice and the repository's current required checks. Include real user-path evidence for changed runtime behavior; include guard-negative evidence only where the workflow contract requires it. Preserve both views, independent task ownership, cycle independence and existing OKR behavior. Record the actual revision and any browser, installed-desktop or measurement evidence required above. One ticket, one merge. Implementation has not started. Use the repository's review-fix v2 and merge procedure when implementation is authorized; this planning ticket does not authorize deployment or production writes.
